rules: Official source split and experiment role are separate fields.
All evaluation cohorts require an exact expected count.
No download, license bypass, or automatic test-to-train relabeling.
No native Game24 verifier is claimed.
Exact duplicate/group checks are implemented; fuzzy/decontamination auditing remains required.

datasets.purpose: Full known-task transfer; historically exposed. New task-family holdout required for new confirmatory claims.
Hard compositional transfer; preserve all task types and long contexts. Do not score only convenient short tasks.
Premise sensitivity and familiar-puzzle bias. Group original/shifted/unpuzzle variants by source puzzle across splits.
Official train for quality learning and group-heldout dev; full official test for final evaluation. Verify actual counts, do not infer from headline rounding.
Train on declared official training subset, stratify difficulty/types; full test and MATH-500 overlap and cannot be pooled as independent data.
500-example standard subset as an efficiency benchmark; actual revision/count locked at preparation.
Arithmetic perturbation stress suite. Source link is historical background, not freshly audited.
Larger-number robustness from PAL; preserve paired source-GSM8K groups and disclose whether train/test source questions overlap.
Essential overlap task for ToT/BoT/PAL. Verify every input number exactly once and exact 24; numeric-answer-only scoring is invalid. Not an implemented native scorer.
Knowledge/reasoning transfer across 14 domains; forbid correctness-conditioned retry_wrong behavior.
Independent small expert-knowledge stress test. Seed and retain choice mapping. Do not train on dataset fields named train in evaluation-only mirrors.
Small-N contest stress test, not headline significance. Lock exact year/version; prior-contest training corpora require question-level contamination audit.
Thinkless-matched RL data option; audit provenance and exclude evaluation-contest/near-duplicate questions before training. Source path is verified via Thinkless README.
Larger training expansion only after source/teacher licensing and decontamination. Suggested candidate, not newly audited/downloading data here.
